title: Artificial Artificial Intelligence: Measuring Influence of AI 'Assessments' on Moral Decision-Making
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not analyze faith or religion. It measures the influence of simulated AI feedback on human moral decision-making in a medical ethics context.
findings: This paper does not study or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on the influence of simulated AI feedback ('Artificial Artificial Intelligence') on human moral decision-making in a secular medical ethics scenario (kidney allocation). The paper finds that participants' decisions can be influenced by feedback they believe is from an AI, even when the feedback is random, and that feedback perceived as coming from human experts has a stronger effect than feedback perceived as coming from an AI.
